summary.note: This is one common cutoff only. Percentages are diagnostic, not a statistically reliable win rate.

EURUSD.lesson: D1 structural uptrend plus lower-timeframe recovery should be handled as buy-pullback, not H1 trend chase.

GBPUSD.lesson: Keep structural/tactical split; bearish H1 pullback did not invalidate D1 bullish context.

USDJPY.lesson: D1 versus H4/H1 conflict justified no-trade; intervention/carry regime requires conflict veto.

USDCHF.lesson: Lower-timeframe oversold condition should trigger wait-for-reversal, not countertrend sell.

USDCAD.lesson: D1 trend plus macro/commodity context should outrank an isolated H1 rebound; sell rejection not chase.

AUDUSD.lesson: D1 bullish context survived H1/M15 pullback; confirmation entry remains preferred.

NZDUSD.lesson: Oversold H4/H1 near RSI 30 plus M5/M1 reversal is a reversal-risk state. Cap bearish confidence and require H1 re-break before SELL.

BTCUSD.lesson: D1/H4 bearish regime dominates M15/M5 bounce; classify bounce as tactical until H1/H4 reclaim.

ETHUSD.lesson: ETH model was too independent. Increase BTC regime and ETHBTC relative-strength weight; bearish BTC should tilt ETH bearish-neutral unless ETH relative strength clearly leads.

XAUUSD.lesson: Updated gold exhaustion rule worked: D1 overbought/HTF resistance plus H1-M15-M5 breakdown must block M5-only buy-the-dip.

finalAdjustments: Keep structural bias separate from tactical bias and entry quality.
Add stretched-trend reversal gate: H4+H1 RSI <=32 or >=68 plus lower-timeframe reversal caps confidence until H1 reconfirms.
Gold long continuation now requires H1 reclaim after deep selloff; M5 reclaim alone is insufficient.
ETH inherits more of BTC regime; pure neutral is disallowed when BTC is structurally bearish unless ETH relative strength strongly offsets it.
Add WRONG_SYMBOL_OR_INSTRUMENT as hard veto; scale validation is mandatory for indices.
Do not count DAX calibration as valid evidence.
Index and silver profiles remain architecturally defined but uncalibrated until a valid free/approved realtime source is connected.
No strategy weight should be further optimized from this single cutoff; next changes require additional out-of-sample cutoffs.
